summary: Risk-first implementation DAG for the finalized strict-goal round/time/token reduction design. Pinned upstream is .strict-goal/sessions/rl_01M52N8D8CJW50XQW9PM1WZ9ZQ/artifacts/sha256-7834436c8df49b67f9b4995d0ea9f9103cb2a8096ee9a3ccdd13762a791ba338.md (sha256:7834436c8df49b67f9b4995d0ea9f9103cb2a8096ee9a3ccdd13762a791ba338); the named design file differs only by one terminal LF and is not modified by this plan. T001 proves live runtime-source identity and captures the pre-change baseline before behavior changes; data contracts and reject-path invariants precede score admission, dependency-aware reuse, and rollout. Every completed task keeps the server test suite green; v2 remains policy/flag-gated until the A/B quality gate passes.

tasks.title: Pin runtime source identity and capture a reproducible v1 baseline
tasks.intent: Before changing a source file, prove that the exercised MCP/server command resolves to the repository copy, record executable/version/path/digest and collect matched v1 fixtures for rounds, tokens, wall clock, issue churn and quality counters. Fail closed when identity is ambiguous.
design_refs: # strict-goal round・時間・token削減 設計仕様
### 1.4 現行根拠の再現手順と提案との境界

changes.note: Add read-only resolved-path, executable and content-digest identity checks that reject a non-repository runtime.
Cover repository identity acceptance and mismatched/missing source rejection.
Store redacted matched baseline fixture and explicit unknown fields.

acceptance: A repository-resolved runtime emits the checked source path and SHA-256 digest, while a mismatched or absent path returns a typed preflight failure before scoring.

The baseline fixture contains phase, artifact/upstream/scope/rubric/environment snapshot digests, rounds, token and wall-clock breakdowns, issue counters and unknown values without secrets or full command output.

verify.command: cd ../strict-goal/server && node -e "const x=require('./test/fixtures/round-reduction/v1-baseline.json'); for (const k of ['phase','snapshot','rounds','tokens','wall_clock','issue_counters']) if (!(k in x)) process.exit(1); console.log('baseline-fixture=ok')"

tasks.title: Introduce versioned v2 evaluation, issue and change-reason contracts
tasks.intent: Add bounded schemas and constructors for IssueRecord v1, CriterionEvaluation v2 and ChangeReason with stable IDs, lifecycle fields, anchor/evidence/resolution bindings and explicit unknown/not-applicable values.
design_refs: ## 4. 採点と issue 台帳の規則

changes.note: Define validated immutable v2 contract constructors and bounded fields.
Publish versioned JSON schema for persisted evaluation records.
Test valid boundaries and rejected missing/oversized/unknown contract fields.

acceptance: Valid records preserve issue_id, first_seen, lifecycle state, severity, anchor clause, evidence locator/digest and resolution condition; records lacking a required binding fail schema validation.
A ChangeReason is one of the documented reasons and cannot silently represent an unknown condition as unchanged.

tasks.title: Persist append-only issue ledger and compact skill-state projection
tasks.intent: Store lifecycle transitions as hash-linked append-only records and project the top three unresolved must_fix entries plus total count and ledger reference without losing the full ledger.
design_refs: ## 4. 採点と issue 台帳の規則

changes.note: Append, hash-chain and query issue lifecycle events including duplicated, reaffirmed, resolved and reopened.
Project ordered compact must_fix summary, unresolved_count and ledger_ref.
Test legal transitions, hash-chain continuity and AC-RR-04 ordering/count boundaries.

acceptance: A four-unresolved-issue fixture returns exactly the oldest/priority-defined three IDs plus unresolved_count=4 and ledger_ref; no fourth issue is discarded from storage.
Illegal lifecycle transitions are rejected with E_ISSUE_STATE_INVALID and each accepted event links to the previous record hash.

tasks.title: Validate score_submit v2 input before round advancement
tasks.intent: Add schema, size/unknown-field, committed-byte digest and exact-excerpt/locator prevalidation. Persist one rejected_prevalidation audit event and preserve effective round; same bytes retry is idempotent and differing bytes are distinct audit events.
design_refs: ### 1.3 提案であり未検証のこと
### 8.3 提出の事前検証と監査境界
### 12.0 自己適用の依存適合性追補

changes.note: Run prevalidation before mutable scoring and return typed reject results.
Verify exact locator excerpts and committed content digests.
Cover unknown fields, byte/digest mismatch, locator mismatch, round invariance and idempotent retries.

acceptance: Schema limit overflow, unknown fields, digest mismatch and excerpt mismatch each create one rejected_prevalidation event, return a typed error and leave effective_round unchanged.
Resending identical payload bytes/submission_id creates no extra event; different bytes create a distinct audit event without being counted as a successful score.

tasks.title: Enforce score, anchor and open-blocking admission rules
tasks.intent: Apply the pass predicate and score<9 evidence/anchor/resolution requirements, rejecting score inflation, missing anchor bindings and finalization with an open blocking issue.
design_refs: ## 4. 採点と issue 台帳の規則

changes.note: Implement context-aware anchor/relevance/staleness and inflation guards.
Apply score admission and FINAL predicate after prevalidation.
Add AC-RR-01, AC-RR-02, AC-RR-03 and AC-RR-07 boundary fixtures.

acceptance: score=8 with an absent required anchor/evidence/resolution binding is rejected; score=8 with all required bindings updates the ledger.
score=9 and open_blocking=1 returns E_ISSUE_STATE_INVALID; score=9 and open_blocking=0 may pass only when all other policy requirements hold.

tasks.title: Build dependency-aware invalidation and conservative cache reuse
tasks.intent: Compute affected criteria from artifact, upstream, scope, rubric, environment and test-selection dependencies; reuse only when all declared dependency values, evidence locator/TTL and environment digest are valid.
design_refs: ## 6. 依存、再評価、キャッシュ
### 6.2 キャッシュ key と無効化
### 12.1 AC-RR-09 の訂正: dependency-cache 診断

changes.note: Calculate dependency-graph invalidation and criterion-local fresh/reused evaluation bases.
Construct documented SHA-256 cache keys from sorted dependency values and verification inputs.
Test intersecting upstream invalidation, unknown dependency, missing locator and environment change.

acceptance: An approved upstream change invalidates only criteria whose dependency declarations intersect it; unaffected criteria remain eligible for reuse.
The AC-RR-09 four cases yield reused only for changed_keys=0, locator=present and environment=known; every other case yields fresh.

tasks.title: Bind approval to condition changes and retain evaluation context
tasks.intent: Persist hash-linked context/approval records and reject unapproved scope, rubric, environment or test-selection changes; mark approved digest-bound changes condition_changed without converting a condition change into artifact improvement.

changes.note: Persist redacted snapshot/context and digest-bound approval bindings.
Reject unapproved condition changes and label approved changes.
Test scope/rubric/environment/test-selection approval and expiration/mismatch boundaries.

acceptance: An unapproved scope_change returns E_SCOPE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; exactly one matching digest-bound approval accepts the change and returns condition_changed=true.
Approval, context and invalidation records store no secret or full command output and retain previous-record hash linkage.

tasks.title: Make rejection, replay and pagination behavior deterministic
tasks.intent: Integrate v2 storage with idempotent submissions, rejected-submission artifacts and bounded oldest-to-newest pagination without duplicate ledger/cache/approval accounting.
design_refs: ### 8.3 提出の事前検証と監査境界

changes.note: Store rejected artifacts, submission idempotency data and bounded return/page cursors.
Return deterministic compact summaries and pagination metadata.
Test replay no-op, distinct submissions and serialize/restore pagination order.

acceptance: The same submission_id is a no-op for round, ledger event, approval use and cache statistics; a different submission_id produces exactly one additional event.
Restoring a bounded page/window preserves oldest-to-newest order and returns a stable cursor/reference rather than dropping unresolved records.

tasks.title: Preserve v1 sessions through versioned migration and policy pinning
tasks.intent: Add dual-read v1/v2 adapters and session-start policy pinning so legacy reload, kickback, rebase, artifact freeze, chain budget and approval tokens remain compatible; v2 enforcement applies only to new flagged sessions.

changes.note: Dual-read v1/v2 session adapter and additive migration helpers.
Pin policy/schema version and feature flags at session creation.
Test legacy reload/rebase/kickback and no mixed v1/v2 score behavior.

acceptance: A legacy v1 fixture reloads and completes existing freeze, chain-budget and approval-token regressions without creating v2 ledger requirements.
A v2 session retains its starting policy across reopen/kickback; rollback disables only new v2 writes and does not mix v1/v2 scores.

tasks.title: Add observability and matched A/B quality release gate
tasks.intent: Record required phase/timing/token/issue/reuse measurements, run paired fixtures that add A through D separately, and prevent default-on promotion if escaped defects or false positives worsen or measurements are missing.

changes.note: Collect documented metric fields and represent absent data as unknown.
Run matched A/B fixtures and assert quality non-regression release criteria.
Provide design-mandated snapshot fixture for anchor, upstream, test exclusion and README defects.

acceptance: Each v2 session/round records phase, client/model/reasoning setting, snapshot digest, fresh/reused counts, invalidation reason, issue events, parent/child token breakdown, LLM/command/approval/idle/wall-clock timing, with missing values recorded as unknown.
The release gate compares matched snapshots and fails promotion when escaped defects or false positives increase, or when round/token/wall-clock reduction lacks the required breakdown.

verify.note: matched A/B metrics and quality gate

tasks.title: Update verifier and worker contracts consistently across distributed skill copies
tasks.intent: Document structured score evidence, mandatory bounded issue/condition/reuse probes and v2 rollout/rollback behavior in the canonical agent guides and generated/distributed copies, with tests that assert behavioral contract parity rather than prose length.

changes.note: Specify v2 evidence, adversarial probes and score-submit validation procedure.
Keep Codex verifier contract synchronized with canonical verifier procedure.
Assert required structured contract tokens/steps across canonical and distributed copies.

acceptance: Every maintained verifier/worker copy instructs the agent to preserve full issue ledger evidence, distinguish fresh from reused evaluation and run conditional scope/rubric/environment/test-selection probes before scoring.
The contract test identifies a missing required procedure in any maintained copy without requiring a fixed prose length.

tasks.title: Publish migration and operator documentation with rollout controls
tasks.intent: Document feature flags, observe-only through default-on stages, new-session-only rollback, policy pinning, additive storage, compatibility period and the separate approval required before v1 removal.

changes.note: Describe user-visible v2 policy, feature flags and safe rollback behavior.
Document migration, compatibility window, metrics gate and deferred v1 removal.
Check required commands and migration/rollback claims against actual flags/policy names.

acceptance: Documentation states that existing sessions retain their start policy, rollback stops new v2 writes, and irreversible v1 removal requires a later separately approved change.
Operator documentation names the A/B quality gate and does not claim a reduction when data is unknown or approval wait is counted as productive work.

tasks.title: Run integrated regression and staged rollout readiness gate
tasks.intent: Execute targeted v2 boundary suites, legacy regressions and the full server suite; create a redacted readiness record only when all tests and the matched quality gate pass, otherwise keep the feature at the preceding stage.
design_refs: ### 12.0 自己適用の依存適合性追補
### 12.1 AC-RR-09 の訂正: dependency-cache 診断

changes.note: Exercise AC-RR-01 through AC-RR-09, legacy regressions and idle-talk snapshot in one integrated flow.
Define redacted expected readiness report shape and selected/deselected/skipped accounting.
Produce readiness status from tests and quality gates without promoting the flag itself.

acceptance: All AC-RR-01 through AC-RR-09 fixtures, legacy session regressions and the complete server test suite pass with exit code 0; any failure leaves the feature at observe-only/previous policy stage.
The readiness record includes collection/selected/deselected/skipped counts and reasons, quality gate result, and no secrets or full command output.

assumptions: Plan artifact scope only: implementation, fixture creation, live MCP deployment, and score submission are excluded. Current validation proves the plan shape and references; future-task test commands are required outputs, not claimed current executions.

All verify commands run from the docs workspace and explicitly cd ../strict-goal/server; success means the named task test exits 0 and reports its asserted boundary. T013 additionally requires npm test exit 0 after its integration test.

Partial-failure rule for every task: do not start a dependent task until its predecessor verification exits 0. Revert only the failing task transaction, retain prior green checkpoints and append-only records, then rerun that task verification before resuming.

Risk order is intentional: T001 resolves runtime identity and baseline uncertainty first; T002-T008 establish contracts, ledger, rejection and cache invariants before migration, A/B gate, skill copies, documentation, and integrated release readiness.

Design traceability is complete when the 32 immutable artifact headings are covered by task design_refs; the document title and context/non-goal headings map to T001, while executable contracts map to T002-T013.
